rv.q: Overall, The Whole Sky All Diamonds is a well-executed immersive theater experience, providing thoughtful commentary on technology’s role in society, its impacts on human interaction, and millennial office politics.
It is funny, strange, and deliberately overwhelming—the kind of workplace where clocking out may leave you wondering whether everyone inside Füfl was ever truly connected at all.

cn.t: Critics praise this immersive tech-startup experience for its inventive staging and emotional depth, with strong marks for transforming audiences into employees in a funny yet poignant exploration of work and human connection.
